records.text: An anonymous Timpanogos Regional Hospital employee told Candace Owens that the hospital had confirmed beyond a shadow of a doubt it was not informed ahead of time that Charlie Kirk was en route.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep mLvJqdxS-FY)

appearances.snippet: I've confirmed that the person works there and they have told me that they have confirmed beyond a shadow of a doubt that the hospital was not informed ahead of time that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was en route.

verification.notes: The transcript shows Owens presenting this as a tip from an unnamed hospital employee, but the employees identity, access, and claimed internal confirmation cannot be independently authenticated. Live searches of current hospital, court, local-news, and emergency-response reporting found no public record resolving whether the hospital received advance notice. This is an attempted verification, not evidence that the anonymous claim is false.

sources.title: Security chief recounts moments after Charlie Kirk was shot
sources.relevance: Current local reporting describes the hospital arrival but does not substantiate the anonymous employees asserted internal confirmation.

links.title: Hospital Reportedly Had No Advance Notice
